annotations.title: IP lookup: owner, network range and country (RDAP)

description: Look up who holds an IP address (v4 or v6) in the regional internet registries' public records (ARIN, RIPE NCC, APNIC, LACNIC, AFRINIC): the holding organisation, network name and range, allocation type, registration country, abuse contact and registry. Use to see which company or ISP an address in a log belongs to. An HTTP call without ip answers for the caller's own address. Registration country, not city location. Example: ip=8.8.8.8. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

ip.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address (over HTTP, left out: the caller's own address)
